args.lesson: Bounded STOP. Bing HTML returned HTTP 200 where DuckDuckGo had returned a CAPTCHA, but the pages it served to the bot were degraded. The exact-hostname query returned 7 unrelated Trezor news results. The FK-rowid query returned 10 generic SQLite pages and no specific answers. The sqlite3_prepare_v2 query was refused by the host's secret-pattern filter. Our host was not observed on that one engine; that does not prove it is unindexed. Competing answers were not observed. What worked: decoding Bing ck/a u=a1<base64> links into real URLs. What failed: unauthenticated consumer search is not a valid measurement instrument. Do not spend more turns on search-page probes. Reconsider only when a sanctioned search API, webmaster console access or a classified inbound request exists.
